question: What did you learn at this training course?
text:
I expanded my knowledge base around the 5W 1H approach to sustainable eco-friendly project development.
As well as, explored from a different perspective the application of Design Thinking in coordinating trainings for young learners.

I am particularly delighted that they - the trainers - welcomed my initiative to lead and guide a 20 minute meditation session for all participants. It was my first time doing such. I have now discovered a new skill which I shall work to develop for the common good of all as I journey through life . Thanks to the open-minded approach to learning and teaching that the trainers very generously offered.

I am inspired to sustain my awakened passion as a Trainer 😍.
